newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: CYCLING-DI GRANDE WINS SPRINT AND FIRST STAGE.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-DI GRANDE WINS SPRINT AND FIRST STAGE.

text.p: Giuseppe Di Grande outsprinted fellow Italian Giuseppe Guerini to win the 167.8-kilometre first stage of the Tour of Romandie on Wednesday.
Di Grande was timed at four hours, 54 minutes and 12 seconds around the hilly lay-out from Kriegstetten to Le Locle, edging out Guerini who clocked the same time.
Michael Boogerd of the Netherlands crossed third, six seconds adrift but two seconds in front of the pack who were led across the line by Russia's Pavel Tonkov.
World one-hour record holder Chris Boardman of Britain, winner of Tuesday's prologue, will continue to wear the leader's green jersey, finishing among the pack in 27th place.
"I really had to suffer today to keep the jersey," Boardman said.
Thursday's second stage will be a 173-km test from Le Locle to Estavayer-le-Lac.
